 "rationale": "Inputs are shifted +0.3 V by matched IR shifts, which keeps the NMOS pair tail alive at ss/-40. The pass gate is driven by a diode with ratio 1/N, so the gate pole scales with load; Mp2 degeneration limits the loop-Gm spread. Low load is output-pole dominant and fast (~1 MHz). DC gain A0 of about 160 gives PSRR and line regulation near 1/T0. Iq is about 45 uA: 10 IREF + 20 tail + 6 shift + 4 divider + ~2 driver."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pass": (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),      # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "L_pass":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.3),
    "N":         (50, 25, 100),         # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "I_tail":    (20e-6, 10e-6, 30e-6), # OTA tail current
    "G":         (5.0, 2.0, 10.0),      # mid-band A_ea*beta_hf
    "wz_ratio":  (4.0, 2.0, 10.0),      # wu_low / wz (lag-lead zero)
    "Rdeg":      (3e3, 0.5e3, 10e3),    # Mp2 source degeneration
    "Cff":       (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12),
    "vshift":    (0.30, 0.22, 0.40),    # input level shift
    "gmid_p2":   (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),    # Mp2 gm/Id at max load
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]; cl = spec["cl"]
    ilmax = spec["iload_max"]; ilmin = spec["iload_min"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    N = int(round(p["N"])); k = 2
    Idiv = 4e-6; Is = 2e-6; It = p["I_tail"]; L1 = 1.0; Lp = p["L_pass"]
    Rdeg = p["Rdeg"]; Cff = p["Cff"]; G = p["G"]

    # divider + level shift (matched currents -> shift cancels exactly)
    Rbot = vref / Idiv; Rtop = (vo - vref) / Idiv
    Rth = Rtop * Rbot / (Rtop + Rbot); Rs = p["vshift"] / Is

    # bias
    mb = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    Wb = mb.W; Wt = Wb * It / iref; Wbp = Wb * Is / iref
    mpb = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Is, vds=0.9)

    # OTA (NMOS pair at ~0.9 V, PMOS mirror load -> X referenced to vin)
    m1 = lut.size("n", 20, L1, It / 2, vds=0.4, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10, L1, It / 2, vds=0.9)
    gm1 = m1.gm; A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)

    # current-mode driver
    I2 = ilmax / (N * k)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p2"], 0.3, I2, vds=0.6)
    mny = lut.size("n", 10, 0.3, I2, vds=0.6)
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, ilmax, vds=0.4)
    Wd = mpass.W / N

    # compensation
    Cp = 0.15e-12
    beta_hf = Cff / (Cff + Cp)
    Amid = G / beta_hf
    Rz = Amid / gm1
    Ipmin = ilmin + Idiv
    Gm_low = Ipmin * 22.0
    wu_low = 0.75 * G * Gm_low / cl
    wz = wu_low / p["wz_ratio"]
    Cz = 1.0 / (wz * Rz)

    gmp2_eff = mp2.gm / (1 + mp2.gm * Rdeg)
    Gm_high = gmp2_eff * k * N
    wu_high = G * Gm_high / cl
    Cg = mpass.cgg * (1 + 1.0 / N)
    pg_high = (mpass.gm / N) / Cg
    pg_low = (Ipmin / N * 24.0) / Cg
    Cx = mp2.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 20e-15
    px = 1.0 / (Rz * Cx)
    deg = lambda a: a * 180 / PI
    pm_high = 90 - deg(math.atan(wu_high / pg_high)) - deg(math.atan(wu_high / px))
    pm_low = 90 - deg(math.atan(wu_low / pg_low)) - deg(math.atan(wz / wu_low))

    # netlist
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.M("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, 1.0)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, 1.0)
    n.M("Mbp", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbp, 1.0)
    n.M("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "na", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms2", "nb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "na", Rs + Rth); n.C("Ca", "na", "vss", 2e-12)
    n.R("Rs", "tap", "nb", Rs); n.C("Cs", "tap", "nb", 2e-12)
    n.R("Rtop", "vout", "tap", Rtop); n.R("Rbot", "tap", "vss", Rbot)
    n.C("Cff", "vout", "tap", Cff)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "nb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", m1.W, L1)   # feedback on diode side
    n.M("M2", "x", "na", "tail", "vss", "nfet", m1.W, L1)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", m3.W, L1)
    n.M("M4", "x", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", m3.W, L1)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "z", Rz); n.C("Cz", "z", "vin", Cz)
    n.R("Rdeg", "vin", "sp2", Rdeg)
    n.M("Mp2", "y", "x", "sp2", "sp2", "pfet", mp2.W, 0.3)
    n.M("Mny", "y", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mny.W, 0.3)
    n.M("Mn", "g", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", k * mny.W, 0.3)
    n.M("Md", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, Lp)
    mf = int(min(200, max(1, round(mpass.W / 20.0))))
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mf)

    # predictions
    T0_high = A0 * 0.5 * Gm_high / mpass.gds
    iq = iref + It + 3 * Is + Idiv + Ipmin / N * (1 + 1.0 / k)
    load_reg = 1e3 * (0.35 / A0 / 0.5) / ilmax + 1.0 / (A0 * 0.5 * Gm_high)
    dx = 0.35
    undershoot = dx / G + 0.05
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 100 * (0.3 / A0 / 0.5) / vo + 0.1,
        "iq": iq,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": 1e3 / T0_high,
        "psrr_1k": 20 * math.log10(T0_high),
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": 0.05,
        "ripple_settled": 0.001,
        "pm_high_deg": pm_high, "pm_low_deg": pm_low,
        "wu_low_hz": wu_low / (2 * PI), "wu_high_hz": wu_high / (2 * PI),
        "A0_db": db(A0), "Cz_pF": Cz * 1e12, "Rz_k": Rz / 1e3,
        "Wpass_um": mpass.W, "vsg_pass_tt": mpass.vgs,
    }
